name: Sheraton Tel Aviv
positioning: Officially Sheraton Grand Tel Aviv, a hotel directly on the beach along the Herbert Samuel Boardwalk, with sea view rooms with balconies and suites looking out over the Mediterranean, within walking distance of the artists' quarter and Jaffa
best_for: Travelers who want to stay directly on the beach in Tel Aviv
Guests who want a sea view room with a balcony or a suite facing the Mediterranean
City explorers who want to walk to Jaffa and the artists' quarter

facts.text: The hotel is on a beachfront spot along the Herbert Samuel Boardwalk, with views of the Mediterranean coastline.
The White City of Tel Aviv, a UNESCO World Heritage site, is 3 km from the hotel.
The hotel has one outdoor pool on-site for hotel guests.
The pool bar offers views of the beach and the Mediterranean Sea.
The fitness center is a fully equipped Technogym fitness center.
The Palm Restaurant serves a daily breakfast buffet and a traditional Shabbat dinner overlooking the Mediterranean.
The &More lobby is a communal space designed for gathering and community.
The hotel is pet-friendly and eco-friendly.
The hotel may organize tours for its guests.
Staff speak Hebrew, English, Russian, French and Spanish.

highlights.text: The hotel is located directly on the beach, with the Mediterranean Sea a few steps from the rooms.
The suites look out over the deep blue Mediterranean and its white sandy beaches.
Sea view rooms include a balcony and views of the Mediterranean.
The hotel is within walking distance of the artists' quarter and Jaffa.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Smoking is prohibited in all hotel rooms, balconies and public areas.
